summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by monday.com Ltd. furnishing a notice and proxy statement for its annual general meeting (AGM) to be held on August 6, 2026. It covers routine proposals including approval of a Compensation Policy and executive compensation terms. No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change—is disclosed. The document is a standard AGM proxy circular and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
